question.text: SEBI has mandated formulation of anti-money laundering policy by:

explanation.text: The Logic: All SEBI-registered intermediaries, including PMs, must formulate AML policy. The Trap: Not limited to banks/MFs/exchanges. Cross-Exam Context: Core framework across XXIV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Review AML policy annually; update it after every FATF/SEBI circular.
